source: Owner-supplied CorelDRAW final SVG exports, 2026-11-07; Inter from rsms/inter official distribution
normalization: Retain all original path coordinates, fills and transforms. Inline class fill rules; convert circles to equivalent two-arc paths and polygons to closed paths. Remove DTD, metadata and unused namespaces. Crop viewBoxes only. No recoloring or optical redesign.
favicon: 32px opaque RGB PNG: resvg-py 0.5.0 renders symbol-dark at 96px high. Pillow 13.0.0 centers it (floor offsets) on an opaque 128px Midnight #080B12 square with alpha_composite, converts to RGB, downsamples to 32px with LANCZOS, and saves an optimized PNG.
horizontal_lockup: 190 x 66 viewBox. Center the unchanged surface symbol in x=2 y=2 w=48 h=62 and the matching wordmark in x=56 y=12 w=133 h=42 with uniform contain scaling. Preserve all child paths, paint and inherited fill rules.
